title: Lamp Error - Replace Lamp
shortDescription: Three or more blinks on lamp LED indicate lamp failure.
fullDescription:
BenQ projectors signal lamp problems via the lamp indicator LED. Three or more blinks typically means the lamp has burned out, reached end of life, or the lamp door is open.

Replace with a genuine BenQ lamp and reset the lamp timer.

fixSteps.title: Replace lamp
fixSteps.instruction: Install new BenQ lamp, reset lamp timer in menu.

videoSearchQuery: BenQ projector lamp LED 3 blinks replacement

faq.a: Menu > System Setup > Lamp Settings > Reset Lamp Timer.

title: Projector Overheating
fullDescription:
BenQ shuts down to protect the lamp when temperature exceeds safe range.

Clean the filter, check all vents, and ensure adequate ventilation.

title: Cooling Fan Failure
shortDescription: Fan not spinning at correct speed.
fullDescription:
Cooling fan has failed or is mechanically obstructed. Unit shuts down immediately.

Usually requires service replacement of the fan assembly.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Listen for fan, check for obstructions via vents.

title: HDMI / HDCP Handshake Error
fullDescription:
HDCP copy-protection handshake between projector and source failed. Common with streaming boxes.

Power cycle all devices and reseat cables.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug projector and source 30 sec each.

faq.a: Try connecting source direct to test.

title: Wi-Fi / Network Connection Failed
fullDescription:
Smart BenQ projectors require network for apps and firmware updates. Connection failures are usually Wi-Fi credential or signal issues.

Re-enter password, move closer to router, or use ethernet.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect
fixSteps.instruction: Forget network and rejoin with correct password.

title: Power LED Amber Blinking
shortDescription: Projector in cooling or startup state.
fullDescription:
An amber blinking power LED usually means the projector is cooling down after shutdown or starting up. Continuous amber blinking after cooldown indicates an internal error.

Wait 2 minutes. If persists, power cycle.
videoSearchQuery: BenQ projector power LED amber blinking

title: Firmware Update Failed
shortDescription: Firmware update process did not complete.
fullDescription:
Update failed mid-process due to power interruption, corrupted file, or network drop. Projector may boot into recovery mode.

Download firmware fresh from BenQ site and retry via USB or network.

fixSteps.title: Redownload
fixSteps.instruction: Get fresh firmware from BenQ support site.

fixSteps.title: Retry via USB
fixSteps.instruction: Put firmware on FAT32 USB, follow recovery steps.

videoSearchQuery: BenQ projector firmware update failed recovery

title: Password / PIN Error
fullDescription:
Projector is locked with a PIN and the entered code is wrong. After 5 attempts, projector enters lockout.

If you forget the PIN, you'll need to use the recovery code from BenQ support.

fixSteps.title: Contact BenQ
fixSteps.instruction: With serial number, request recovery code.

videoSearchQuery: BenQ projector PIN recovery forgot password

title: Lamp Approaching End of Life
shortDescription: Lamp usage hours exceeded manufacturer rating.
fullDescription:
Lamp has exceeded rated hours (typically 2000-5000). Image will dim and eventually fail.

Replace lamp soon to avoid catastrophic failure.

causes.cause: Lamp at end of rated hours

fixSteps.title: Plan replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Order OEM lamp now; continue use at own risk.

videoSearchQuery: BenQ projector lamp end of life replace

title: Power Button Mechanical Fault
shortDescription: Projector won't power on/off due to stuck button.
fullDescription:
The physical power button on the projector or remote is mechanically stuck from dust or wear.

Use remote or clean button gently; severe cases require service.

fixSteps.title: Use remote
fixSteps.instruction: Try remote control with fresh batteries.

fixSteps.title: Clean button
fixSteps.instruction: Blow compressed air around button edges.

videoSearchQuery: BenQ projector power button stuck fix

faq.a: Yes, use it while awaiting service.
